items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Teddy Hill was the manager of the club at that time and that was an old band buddy of yours.

ctx.x: On one of the records Louis Metcalf played trumpet, you on trombone, Albert Nicholas, Teddy Hill played tenor saxophone, Will Johnson guitar, Moore bass, Fats Picon ... /When Jay C. To EK: came to New York in 1928, did you follow his career?
